episodes.synopsis: After All Might announces his retirement, freelance reporter Taneo Tokuda goes to the dorms to investigate U.A. Class 1-A.
episodes.title: The Scoop on U.A. Class 1-A

episodes.synopsis: Overhaul pays a visit to the League of Villains, and Midoriya tries to find a place to do his work study.
episodes.title: Overhaul

episodes.synopsis: Izuku battles Sir Nighteye so he can do his work study at Nighteye’s agency, but Nighteye has someone else in mind to be All Might’s successor…
episodes.title: Boy Meets…

episodes.synopsis: Izuku’s mind is swirling with feelings from his work study, so he goes and talks to All Might about it and learns about All Might’s fate.
episodes.title: Fighting Fate

episodes.synopsis: The U.A. work study students go out with their respective heroes and become involved in some big fights.
episodes.title: Let’s Go, Gutsy Red Riot

episodes.synopsis: The work study students from U.A. attend a meeting of heroes gathered by Sir Nighteye and leave with new resolve.
episodes.title: An Unpleasant Talk

episodes.synopsis: The work study students wait until the pro heroes find Eri and it’s time to start the operation to save her.
episodes.title: GO!!

episodes.synopsis: The Shie Hassaikai is going all out to stop the heroes, and Suneater volunteers to take out the first batch of Eight Bullets members in their way.
episodes.title: Suneater of the Big Three

episodes.synopsis: As the fight with the Shie Hassaikai continues, Kirishima has to face his past when he and Fat Gum get separated from the others.
episodes.title: Red Riot

episodes.synopsis: The Hassaikai gets some help from the League of Villains as the heroes continue to make their way to Chisaki to rescue Eri.
episodes.title: Temp Squad

episodes.synopsis: The League of Villains stay true to their name in their fight. Meanwhile, Togata catches up to Chisaki and Eri first…
episodes.title: Lemillion

episodes.synopsis: Izuku, Eraser Head, and Sir Nighteye finally reach the area where Chisaki and the others are and find Togata past his limit…
episodes.title: Unforeseen Hope

episodes.synopsis: As the fight with the Shie Hassaikai reaches its climax, Chisaki looks back on how it all started, and Izuku uses All For One at 100%.
episodes.title: Infinite 100%

episodes.synopsis: As the heroes deal with the aftermath of the fight with the Shie Hassaikai, the vehicle transporting Chisaki has an encounter with the League of Villains…
episodes.title: Bright Future

episodes.synopsis: After the fight with the Shie Hassaikai, a new villain emerges, and the students who participated reflect on their own roles as future heroes.
episodes.title: Smoldering Flames

episodes.synopsis: Camie joins the provisional license training course and is added to the team working with the kids from Masegaki. Meanwhile, Endeavor has a serious talk with All Might.
episodes.title: Win Those Kids’ Hearts

episodes.synopsis: The trainees bond with the precocious Masegaki kids and life at U.A. goes back to normal as autumn approaches, but Aoyama has been acting strangely…
episodes.title: Relief for License Trainees

episodes.synopsis: As the students of U.A. prepare for their school festival, Deku and Togata visit Eri in the hospital. Meanwhile, a new villain named Gentle Criminal begins his reign of crime.
episodes.title: School Festival

episodes.synopsis: Class 1-A assigns roles for their performance at the school festival, and Gentle starts preparing his next plan.
episodes.title: Prepping for the School Festival Is the Most Fun Part

episodes.synopsis: Eri visits U.A. while the students are preparing for the school festival, and Gentle finalizes his plans.
episodes.title: Gold Tips Imperial

episodes.synopsis: As Deku buys some last-minute supplies for the school festival, he encounters a mysterious man wrapped in a trench coat…
episodes.title: Deku vs. Gentle Criminal

episodes.synopsis: Izuku must stop Gentle Criminal and his partner, La Brava, or else the school festival will be cancelled.
episodes.title: School Festival Start!!

episodes.synopsis: Izuku rushes back to the school festival after his encounter with Gentleman and La Brava, but will he make it in time for his performance?
episodes.title: Let It Flow! School Festival!

episodes.synopsis: It’s time for the next Japanese Hero Billboard Chart rankings to be announced, and this time, all the top ten heroes make an appearance.
episodes.title: Japanese Hero Billboard Chart

episodes.synopsis: Endeavor and Hawks are up against High-End, and it’s Endeavor’s chance to show the world what the new number one hero is like.
episodes.title: His Start
